hook: Two fatal factory explosions forced Andhra Pradesh to overhaul its entire fireworks safety framework.

sections.voiceover: Two fatal factory explosions forced Andhra Pradesh to overhaul its entire fireworks safety framework.
sections.visual_cue: Map of Andhra Pradesh highlighting the state boundaries.
sections.sfx_cue: Distant, muffled industrial boom followed by a sharp silence.
b_roll: Stock footage of industrial fireworks manufacturing

sections.voiceover: These mandates follow explosions at Sri Ganapathi Grand Fireworks and Surya Sri Fire Works. But how does the Director-General of State Disaster Response and Fire Services monitor these high-risk facilities?
sections.visual_cue: Official government document header with date visible.
sections.sfx_cue: Sound of a digital file being stamped.
b_roll: Close up of an official government document
Architectural exterior of a generic manufacturing facility

sections.voiceover: However, the new framework makes inspecting officers personally accountable for safety compliance at every manufacturing unit.
sections.visual_cue: Logo or insignia of the State Disaster Response and Fire Services department.

sections.voiceover: Inspectors are now personally accountable for safety compliance under these strict rules. Andhra Pradesh will now enforce risk-based inspections across every fireworks manufacturing facility.

sections.voiceover: These rules officially took effect on November 7, 2026.
